disambiguation: Not a code linter; it is a multi-provider AI chat and academic research tool.
extras: Desktop only (macOS, Windows, Linux). Academic skills are research aids, not oracles.
intentEvidence: An Obsidian plugin that puts four AI assistants in your sidebar — each chat tab can run a different provider.
motivation: Built for researchers who write in Obsidian and want to compare model takes, edit manuscripts, check citations, and run peer-review workflows without leaving the editor.
problem: Researchers often need to compare outputs from multiple AI models and perform complex academic analysis without leaving the Obsidian editor.

relations.evidence: Original integration. Full feature set: streaming, tools, inline diff, thinking blocks, MCP.
Streams text, tool calls, inline diff (replace tool aliased to Edit).
Reasoning effort wired (model_reasoning_effort), MCP, web search.
Chat only — agy v1.0.2 doesn't yet expose structured output.

summary: Multi-provider AI chat plugin that integrates Claude, Gemini, Codex, and Antigravity into the Obsidian sidebar, featuring inline diff editing and academic research skills.
